messages.en:
{07 14 00}Oh, hey, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}
Doesn't the {ff 00 00 03}Fishing Tourney
{ff 00 00 00}start today?
{07 15 00}You'd better believe I'm
going to be the one to
take home the {ff 00 00 07}trophy{ff 00 00 00}!

{07 14 00}Oh, tere, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}
Kas {ff 00 00 03}kalapüügivõistlus
{ff 00 00 00}ei alga täna?
{07 15 00}Võid kindel olla, et mina

{ff 00 00 07}karika{ff 00 00 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I've been trying out my new
training regimen for the
{ff 00 00 03}Fishing Tourney{ff 00 00 00}.
I stick my face in the
river and {07 09 00}become one with
the fish{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 00 00}I can't do it for long,{01 00 00 05 00}
but I've learned so much
about how fish think.
{07 11 00}Those fish aren't gonna
stand a chance against me
this year, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ma olen proovinud oma uut
treeningkava {ff 00 00 03}kalapüügi-
võistluseks{ff 00 00 00}.
Ma pistan näo jõkke
ja {07 09 00}saan kaladega
üheks{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 00 00}Ma ei suuda seda kaua teha,{01 00 00 05 00}
aga olen palju õppinud
kalade mõtlemisest.
{07 11 00}Neil kaladel pole sel aastal
minu vastu mingit
võimalust, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}So, are you all set,
{04 1f 00}? The {ff 00 00 03}Fishing
Tourney{ff 00 00 00} starts today!
{07 00 00}I'm not worried about
winning right now. I'm just
relaxing and having fun.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Nii, kas sa oled valmis,
{04 1f 00}? {ff 00 00 03}Kalapüügi-
võistlus{ff 00 00 00} algab täna!
{07 00 00}Ma ei muretse praegu
võitmise pärast. Ma lihtsalt
lõõgastun ja lõbutsen.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}You may not know it,
{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} but I'm the
current record holder.
{07 0d 00}That's right! I caught that
massive {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}-inch{ff 00 00 00}
{0b 02 00}{04 1a 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Sa ei pruugi seda teada,
{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} aga mina olen
praegune rekordiomanik.
{07 0d 00}Just nii! Ma püüdsin selle
massiivse {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}-tollise{ff 00 00 00}
{0b 02 00}{04 1a 00}!

messages.en:
I just caught a
{0b 02 00}{04 1a 00}!

You should have seen it! It
was {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} inches{ff 00 00 00} long!

{07 14 00}That's the fish that put me
in the lead as the record
holder, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
Ma püüdsin just
{0b 02 00}{04 1a 00}!

Sa oleksid pidanud nägema!
See oli {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} tolli{ff 00 00 00} pikk!

{07 14 00}See on kala, mis viis mu
rekordiomanikuna
juhtima, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I'm in the lead right now,
thanks to my {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}-inch {ff 00 00 00}
{0b 02 00}{04 1a 00}!
{07 14 00}I'm glad I caught it, but I
have to tell you, it was
just beginner's luck.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ma juhin praegu tänu oma
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}-tollisele {ff 00 00 00}
{0b 02 00}{04 1a 00}!
{07 14 00}Hea, et ma selle püüdsin,
aga pean ütlema, et see
oli lihtsalt algaja õnn.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Oh, hey, {04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} Say,
if you find a good spot for
fishing, let me know.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Oh, tere, {04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} Kuule,
kui sa leiad hea koha
kalapüügiks, anna teada.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I concentrate better {01 00 00 05 00}when
there's nobody else fishing
near me, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 14 00}When it's nice and quiet,
the fish don't get spooked
and run away, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ma keskendun paremini, {01 00 00 05 00}kui
keegi teine minu lähedal
ei kalasta, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 14 00}Kui on kena ja vaikne,
ei ehmu kalad ära
ja ei põgene, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Right now, {04 10 00} is in
the lead with the biggest
fish, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 15 00}But I'm not quitting yet!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Praegu juhib {04 10 00}
kõige suurema
kalaga, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 15 00}Aga ma ei anna veel alla!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}If you run around, stomping
your feet everywhere you
go, the fish get scared!
If you don't hook them at
the right time, the fish
get scared, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 06 00}Who knew fish were such
sensitive creatures?!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Kui sa jooksed ringi ja
trambid igal pool, siis
kalad ehmuvad!
Kui sa ei tõmba õigel ajal,
siis kalad ehmuvad,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 06 00}Kes teadis, et kalad on nii
tundlikud olendid?!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I was doing really well for
a while there.

{07 0f 00}Up until {04 10 00} stole
my fishing spot, that is{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Mul läks mõnda aega
tõesti hästi.

{07 0f 00}Kuni {04 10 00} varastas
mu kalakoha, jah{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.

{07 15 00}I'm not gonna lose to that!

{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} the secret to

Forget about the {ff 00 00 07}trophy{ff 00 00 00},

only{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 0c 00}with a fishing rod.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00} fish are VERY
sensitive to loud noises.
You know that, right?
{07 16 00}If you run around near the
water, they'll hear you and
freak out, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00} kalad on VÄGA

Sa tead seda, eks?
{07 16 00}Kui sa jooksed vee lähedal
ringi, kuulevad nad sind ja
lähevad segaseks, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
